_doc: Args for the next kd-improve round (see docs/agenti.md). Ideas and critic verdicts from round 1 (2026-10-07); recurring-kingdom-events (round 1), discord-login and governor-registration (round 2, 2026-10-08) are shipped and removed. Round 2 was stopped by Gether right after privacy-page started (nothing left half-done). Since then a terms page (/podmienky, footer link) exists – the privacy page goes next to it in the footer; the domain is kd1035.eu. Gether dropped Governor registration on 2026-10-08 (model and R4 group removed, accounts/0004); players only add their in-game name (Player.ingame_name) on /ucet. r4-admin-access and leadership-discord-alerts are rejected for that reason. Next big item from Gether: players choose events and their own reminder times (see backlog).

ideas.title: Discord message preview, test send and duplicate in admin
ideas.title_sk: Náhľad Discord správy, testovacie odoslanie a duplikovanie v admine
ideas.user_value: Today the only way to see what a notification looks like is the 'Odoslať na Discord hneď' action, which posts to the real channel, pings the role and marks the row as sent. A preview plus a test send to a private channel lets Gether check wording, pings and timestamps safely before anything reaches members. Duplicating a notification a week ahead saves retyping for irregular repeats.
ideas.spec:
1) discord.py: build_payload(notification) + send(payload, url). If recurring-kingdom-events already introduced them, reuse them; otherwise do the refactor here and keep post() as a wrapper. New setting DISCORD_TEST_WEBHOOK_URL (env; .env.example: 'webhook of a PRIVATE test channel, used by the admin action Poslať test'). 2) kingdom/admin_preview.py: render_preview(payload) returns HTML that approximates a Discord message, with the same inline-style approach as the guide preview in guides/admin.py. Discord colors are allowed as a brand exception: #313338 background, gold left border (GOLD), bot name 'Kingdom 1035', role chip '@rola' when a ping is set, bold title, description, embed fields, footer 'KD 1035 · CZ/SK'. Every piece of user text goes through escape()/format_html. Supported markdown is limited to newlines →
, **bold**, and [text](https url). // tokens are shown as Bratislava date/time text. A small label reads 'približný náhľad'. 3) EventNotificationAdmin: read-only field 'Náhľad na Discorde' (shown after the first save), save_on_top=True. Action 'Poslať test do testovacieho kanála': posts the payload with title '[TEST] …', empty content and allowed_mentions {'parse': []} to DISCORD_TEST_WEBHOOK_URL. It never changes status, sent_at or error. When the env var is missing it shows an error message and sends nothing. An object-tool button 'Poslať test' on the change form (custom admin URL /test/, POST with CSRF, superuser only, redirect back with a message). 4) Action 'Duplikovať o týždeň': copies title, message, mention_role, mention_role_id and event_start (+7 days if set) with send_at + 7 days and status PENDING. Event-generated rows are copied without the event link. 5) list_display: a 'kedy' column with relative Slovak text ('o 2 h 15 min', 'pred 3 dňami') and a colored status pill (format_html, fixed admin-only colors). 6) If KingdomEvent exists: the same preview on its change form (rendered for the next occurrence) and the same test action. 7) README: test channel setup. TESTS: the test action posts to the test URL without a role mention and the status stays PENDING; a missing test URL gives an error and no HTTP call (mock urlopen); duplicate shifts send_at by 7 days; the preview escapes '
acceptance_criteria: The change form of a saved notification shows a Discord-like preview with title, text, role chip (when a ping is set) and timestamps rendered as readable Bratislava time.
'Poslať test' posts to DISCORD_TEST_WEBHOOK_URL with a '[TEST]' title and no role mention; the notification's status, sent_at and error are unchanged (test).
Without DISCORD_TEST_WEBHOOK_URL the action shows a clear Slovak error and makes no HTTP request (test).
'Duplikovať o týždeň' creates PENDING copies with send_at (and event_start) shifted by exactly 7 days.
HTML or script in a title or message appears escaped in the preview (test).
All new admin views and actions are available only to superusers; DISCORD_TEST_WEBHOOK_URL is documented in .env.example without a value.
needs_from_user: Webhook URL of a private test channel on the kingdom Discord (DISCORD_TEST_WEBHOOK_URL in .env)
ideas.risks: Discord markdown is only approximated, so the preview must be labelled as approximate. If the test webhook points to a public channel, tests leak to members; README must say 'private channel'. Low risk otherwise.

ideas.title: Public SK/CZ event calendar page
ideas.user_value: Members get one place that shows what happens in the kingdom and when, in their own local time with the game time (UTC) next to it, without scrolling Discord history. Migrants see an active, organized kingdom. Each event can link to its guide.
ideas.spec:
BACKEND
1) GET /api/events/?days=N (default 31, clamp 1–62), kingdom/views.py + serializer. Returns occurrences of active KingdomEvents with show_on_web, from (now − duration) so running events appear, up to now + N days. Sorted by start, capped at 300 items. Item: {id, name_sk, name_cs, start (ISO, UTC), end (ISO or null when duration 0), repeat_days, guide: {category, slug, title_sk, title_cs} | null (only published guides)}. Reuses kingdom/events.occurrences. Never exposes message or role fields. Response header Cache-Control: public, max-age=300.
2) guides/views.py STATIC_PAGES += ['/kalendar'].
FRONTEND
3) core/events-api.ts EventsApi (providedIn root, httpResource only in the browser, same pattern as GuidesApi): ready(), failed(), all(), name(e) with CS→SK fallback, a days() computed that groups by local calendar day.
4) pages/calendar/calendar.ts|html|scss: route 'kalendar' in pages() (so /kalendar and /cz/kalendar both exist), Page 'calendar' in i18n.ts parseUrl plus I18n.path('calendar'). Prerendered shell (covered by the '**' Prerender server route); data loads in the browser. app-page-header with crumbs Domov › Kalendár.
   Agenda list grouped by day; the heading is 'Dnes' / 'Zajtra' / weekday + date via Intl in i18n.locale(). Row: local time range 'HH:mm–HH:mm', secondary 'UTC 12:00', name, tag 'Prebieha' while now is between start and end, a small repeat label ('každý týždeň', 'každé 2 týždne', 'denne'), and a 'Návod' link (routerLink via i18n.guidePath) when a guide is set.
   States: 3 skeleton rows while loading, empty state 'Zatiaľ nie sú naplánované žiadne eventy.', error text. One short note line: local times and UTC = game time.
   'Prebieha' refreshes through a 60 s signal timer started in afterNextRender and cleared on destroy (SSR-safe).
5) Header: new nav item 'Kalendár' (desktop + drawer) → i18n.path('calendar') with routerLinkActive. Verify the bar still fits at 900, 1024 and 1280 px.
6) Seo: t.seo.calendar {title, description} in both dictionaries; Seo uses fixed texts for 'calendar' the way it does for home/about. Keywords stay natural (e.g. 'Kalendár eventov · KD 1035 Rise of Kingdoms CZ/SK').
7) i18n: a 'calendar' section in sk.ts and cs.ts with identical structure; repeat labels use Intl.PluralRules like GuidesApi.count.
8) Styles: only tokens from styles.scss, dark, visible focus, transform/opacity animations with prefers-reduced-motion, 320 px → 2560 px. Screenshots at 360/768/1280/1920/2560.
TESTS: backend (inactive or hidden events excluded; running event included; days clamped; no message/role keys; unpublished guide → null); frontend: day grouping/labels unit test and parseUrl cases for /kalendar and /cz/kalendar.
acceptance_criteria: /kalendar and /cz/kalendar are prerendered at build time without the API, have correct title/description/canonical/hreflang, and both appear in sitemap.xml.
With events in the DB, the page lists the next 31 days grouped by day with local times and UTC times; a running event shows 'Prebieha'.
Events with show_on_web=false or is_active=false never appear in /api/events/; the response contains no message or mention_role_id (test).
An event linked to a published guide shows a working 'Návod' link in the correct language.
With no events the page shows the empty state; with the API down it shows the error text; nothing breaks.
The header contains 'Kalendár' on desktop and in the mobile drawer, keyboard reachable, with no overflow at 900–1280 px.
Every text exists in SK and CZ; the i18n spec, ng build and backend tests pass.
needs_from_user: Which events are public and their Czech names
ideas.risks: An empty calendar looks dead until leadership fills it, so the empty state must look intentional. The server must always send UTC ISO and the browser converts it. A 6th nav item may crowd the header at mid widths; check the screenshots.

ideas.title: Privacy page and data minimisation for player accounts
ideas.title_sk: Stránka Ochrana údajov a minimalizácia uložených dát
ideas.audience: All visitors who sign in; Gether as the operator
ideas.user_value: With Discord login and Governor registration the site starts storing personal data. A short, factual privacy page plus automatic clean-up of stale data keeps the site GDPR-compliant and builds trust in a small community where everyone knows each other.
ideas.spec:
1) Page /ochrana-udajov and /cz/ochrana-udajov: route in pages(), Page 'privacy' in parseUrl, I18n.path('privacy'), prerendered, STATIC_PAGES += ['/ochrana-udajov'], Seo fixed texts t.seo.privacy. Same layout as About (app-page-header + structured blocks), short.
2) Content in the sk.ts / cs.ts 'privacyPage' section, as headings plus 1–2 sentences or short lists each: who runs the site (controller, from Gether); what we store (Discord ID, name, avatar hash; Governor ID, in-game name, kind, alliance, registration status); why (identity for R4 approval, kingdom roster); who sees it (R4 and admins only; nothing is public); how long (until account deletion; rejected registrations 90 days); cookies (only the technically necessary session + csrftoken, so no consent banner); how to delete ('Zmazať účet' on /ucet); contact. It must match the fields that actually exist; no promises about features that do not exist.
3) Links: footer (small link next to the fan-site note), the login note on /ucet, and under the governor registration form.
4) Worker data minimisation: once a day (monotonic gate) delete Governor rows with status 'rejected' and reviewed_at older than 90 days (function in accounts, called from run_worker, logged count).
5) CLAUDE.md: rule that every new personal-data field must be added to the privacy page.
TESTS: purge deletes only old rejected entries; parseUrl for the new path; dictionary shape test passes.
acceptance_criteria: /ochrana-udajov and /cz/ochrana-udajov are prerendered with their own title/description, appear in sitemap.xml and are linked from the footer on every page.
The page lists exactly the data fields stored by the accounts app, retention, cookie use (session + csrftoken only) and how to delete the account.
/ucet links to the page from the login note and from the registration form.
The worker deletes rejected registrations older than 90 days and keeps everything else (unit test).
All texts are in SK and CZ with correct diacritics; the layout is readable at 320 px and 1920 px.
needs_from_user: Name/contact of the data controller (Gether or the kingdom leadership) and a contact channel
Confirmation of the 90-day retention for rejected registrations
ideas.risks: This is not legal advice; keep it factual and in sync with the code. It is a legal page and an exception to the 'no text ballast' rule, but it should still be short and structured. Low technical risk.

ideas.title: Admin overview: worker health, upcoming and failed notifications
ideas.title_sk: Prehľad v admine: stav workera, najbližšie a zlyhané notifikácie
ideas.user_value: The site has to run with little effort. Today Gether cannot tell from the admin whether the worker is alive, whether the last backup is recent, whether a reminder failed, or what goes out next. One panel on the admin start page answers all of that in a few seconds.
ideas.spec:
1) Worker heartbeat without DB noise: run_worker writes /app/data/worker_status.json (on the db_data volume shared by backend and worker in both compose files) once per tick: {last_tick (ISO), last_backup_at, last_backup_file}, written atomically via a temp file + os.replace. It is a file, not a DB row, so the git snapshot does not change every 30 s. The backend reads it; production backend does not mount BACKUP_DIR, which is why backup info comes from this file.
2) TEMPLATES['DIRS'] = [BASE_DIR / 'templates'] (if not already added by r4-admin-access). backend/templates/admin/index.html extends 'admin/index.html' and adds a 'Prehľad' block above the app list. The context comes from a small helper (kingdom/dashboard.py), passed by wrapping admin.site.index with extra_context, or via a custom AdminSite subclass keeping the same registry.
3) Superuser blocks: worker status (OK if last_tick < 2 min, otherwise red 'Worker nebeží' with the time); last backup age (warning when older than BACKUP_INTERVAL_DAYS + 1 day or missing); next 5 PENDING notifications (time in Bratislava, title, link to change page); FAILED notifications in the last 7 days (count + link to the changelist filtered by ?status__exact=failed); configuration flags as 'nastavené' / 'chýba' for DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL, DISCORD_EVENT_ROLE_ID, DISCORD_TEST_WEBHOOK_URL, DISCORD_STAFF_WEBHOOK_URL, Discord login. Values are never shown, only booleans (use getattr with default, since some settings come from later slices). Guides published/unpublished counts.
4) Blocks for staff with the permission: pending governor registrations count + link (only when the accounts.Governor model exists and the user has view_governor).
5) Styling uses Django admin CSS variables (--body-fg, --message-error-bg, --message-warning-bg …) so it works in admin light/dark; no new design-system colors.
TESTS: helper returns 'stale' for an old heartbeat and 'missing' without the file; the index page renders for a superuser with the blocks; a staff user without permissions does not see notification data; no secret value appears in the HTML (assert the webhook URL is not in the response).
acceptance_criteria: The admin start page shows a 'Prehľad' panel for superusers with worker status, last backup age, the next 5 pending notifications and the count of failed notifications in the last 7 days, all linking to the right admin pages.
Stopping the worker container makes the panel show 'Worker nebeží' within 2 minutes.
Configuration rows show only 'nastavené'/'chýba'; no webhook URL or secret appears in the HTML (test).
A non-superuser staff user sees no notification or worker data; with the registration feature present, R4 sees only the pending-registrations count.
No DB writes happen per worker tick (heartbeat is a file); export_snapshot stays byte-identical when content did not change.
ideas.risks: The admin template override must keep the default app list intact across Django upgrades; extending admin/index.html and only adding a block keeps it safe. The heartbeat file lives in the db_data volume, so check file ownership (the worker runs as app via setpriv).

ideas.title: R4 access to the admin via Discord login and roster export
ideas.title_sk: Prístup R4 do adminu cez Discord a export zoznamu governorov
ideas.audience: R4/R5 leadership; superadmin who grants access
ideas.user_value: R4s approve registrations without Gether creating and sharing passwords: they sign in with Discord and land in the admin with only the rights they need. Leadership can export the approved roster to a spreadsheet for KvK planning.
ideas.spec:
1) TEMPLATES['DIRS'] = [BASE_DIR / 'templates'] (if not already present). backend/templates/admin/login.html extends 'admin/login.html' and adds a 'Prihlásiť cez Discord' button below the form, linking to /api/auth/discord/login/?next=/admin/, shown only when Discord login is configured (context processor or template tag reading settings). Password login stays for the superuser. Because Discord login calls django login(), the same session works in /admin/ (same origin behind nginx; in dev cookies are shared across ports on localhost).
2) PlayerAdmin actions (superuser only): 'Pridať do R4 (prístup do adminu)' → user.is_staff=True + add group 'R4' (get_or_create); 'Odobrať R4' → remove the group and set is_staff=False unless the user is a superuser. list_display gets an 'R4' boolean column. Messages in Slovak.
3) GovernorAdmin action 'Exportovať schválených do CSV' (available to anyone with view_governor): an HttpResponse text/csv with UTF-8 BOM, ';' separator (Excel in SK/CZ locale), columns: Meno v hre, Governor ID, Typ, Aliancia, Discord meno, Discord ID, Schválené (date). Exports only approved rows among the selected ones (or all approved when 'select all'). Filename kd1035-governori-YYYY-MM-DD.csv.
4) /api/auth/me/ adds pending_governors (int, only when the user has accounts.view_governor, otherwise omitted). /ucet shows for staff: an 'Administrácia' link (/admin/) and 'Čaká na schválenie: N' when N > 0.
5) README: how to make someone R4 (they sign in once with Discord → Admin → Hráči → action). CLAUDE.md: R4 = staff + group R4 via Discord login.
TESTS: actions toggle is_staff/group; removing R4 from a superuser keeps is_staff; CSV contains only approved rows and starts with a BOM; me/ returns pending_governors only with the permission; the admin login page contains the Discord button only when configured.
acceptance_criteria: After the superuser applies 'Pridať do R4' to a player, that player can open /admin/ after signing in with Discord, sees only Governor registrations (and read-only players), and can approve them.
'Odobrať R4' immediately removes admin access (is_staff false, group removed), but never removes is_staff from a superuser.
The admin login page shows 'Prihlásiť cez Discord' only when DISCORD_CLIENT_ID/SECRET are set, and that flow lands on /admin/.
The CSV export opens correctly in Excel with diacritics (UTF-8 BOM, ';') and contains only approved governors (test).
/ucet shows an 'Administrácia' link and the pending count for R4; normal players see neither.
Texts are in SK and CZ on the website; admin texts are in Slovak; all tests pass.
needs_from_user: Decision: should R4 also edit Alliance/Officer/Links in admin (default: registrations only)
ideas.risks: A compromised R4 Discord account means access to the roster, so recommend Discord 2FA for R4 in the README and keep R4 permissions minimal. The superuser keeps password login as a fallback.

ideas.title: Leadership alerts on Discord: new registrations and failed reminders
ideas.title_sk: Upozornenia pre vedenie na Discorde: nové registrácie a zlyhané pripomienky
ideas.user_value: Registrations get approved quickly because R4s see them where they already are, with a direct link to the admin. Gether learns about a failed or missed member reminder right away instead of discovering it days later.
ideas.spec:
1) Env DISCORD_STAFF_WEBHOOK_URL (.env.example: PRIVATE leadership channel). Empty → the feature is silently off (one info log at worker start).
2) Uses discord.send(payload, url) from the refactor (build it here if missing). Staff messages never ping anyone: allowed_mentions {'parse': []}.
3) Governor.staff_notified_at (DateTime, null; additive migration). On each worker tick, pending governors with staff_notified_at null get one embed 'Nová registrácia governora': name, Governor ID, kind, alliance tag, Discord <@id> (rendered as a mention but not pinged), and a link SITE_URL + /admin/accounts/governor/<pk>/change/. On success staff_notified_at = now. When there are more than 5 at once, send one summary message ('N nových registrácií' + changelist link ?status__exact=pending) and mark them all. On failure, leave staff_notified_at null and retry next tick, with log.warning and no alert loop.
4) EventNotification.staff_alerted (bool, default False; additive). When a notification becomes FAILED (from deliver() or the missed-6h path in send_due), the worker sends 'Notifikácia sa neodoslala: <title>' with the error (truncated to 300 chars) and an admin link, then sets staff_alerted=True. A failure of the staff webhook itself is only logged.
5) Pre-existing pending governors and old failed notifications at deploy time: a data migration marks them as already alerted so the first run does not spam.
6) README: create the staff webhook in a private channel.
TESTS (urlopen mocked): one alert per new registration; no alert when unset; summary for >5; failed notification alerts once; staff webhook failure does not raise and retries next tick; the migration marks existing rows.
acceptance_criteria: A new governor registration produces exactly one message in the staff channel within one worker tick (≤30 s), with the admin link and no ping (test asserts allowed_mentions parse is empty).
A reminder that fails or is skipped as missed produces exactly one staff alert containing the error text.
Without DISCORD_STAFF_WEBHOOK_URL nothing is sent and nothing errors.
If the staff webhook is down, the worker keeps running, retries the registration alert on the next tick, and never alerts about its own failure.
Deploying the migration does not send alerts for registrations or failures that existed before.
needs_from_user: DISCORD_STAFF_WEBHOOK_URL of a private leadership channel
ideas.risks: A staff webhook in a public channel would leak Governor IDs, so the README must stress 'private'. Keep the per-tick volume bounded (summary message) so Discord rate limits are not hit.

ideas.title: Upcoming events teaser on the home page
ideas.audience: Members and visitors landing on the home page
ideas.user_value: Most visits start on the home page. Showing the next three events there makes the site something members check regularly, and it shows migrants an active kingdom, without opening the calendar.
ideas.spec:
1) New home section component pages/home/upcoming/upcoming.ts|scss (id 'events'), placed between <app-alliance> and <app-guides> in home.ts.
2) Data from EventsApi (public-event-calendar): the next 3 occurrences that are running or start in the future. Compact cards: day label ('Dnes', 'Zajtra', short date), local time + 'UTC hh:mm', name, 'Prebieha' tag when running, guide link when set. Below: 'Celý kalendár' link → i18n.path('calendar').
3) The section is not rendered at all while loading, when the API fails, or when there are no events (follows the 'section hides' rule; prerendered HTML has no empty box). It appears with appReveal (transform/opacity, reduced-motion respected).
4) i18n: 'upcoming' section (eyebrow, title, link) in sk.ts and cs.ts. Tokens only, responsive (1 column on mobile, 3 on desktop).
5) Screenshots at 360/768/1280/1920/2560 with events present.
acceptance_criteria: With public events in the DB, the home page (SK and CZ) shows at most 3 upcoming or running events with local and UTC times and a working 'Celý kalendár' link.
With no events, or with the API down, the section is absent and the home page looks exactly as before.
The prerendered home HTML contains no empty events section; there is no console error during prerender.
Cards are keyboard accessible, readable at 320 px, and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
ideas.risks: The section appears after hydration, which shifts content below it. It sits below the fold under the alliance card, so the impact is small, but check it in screenshots.

ideas.title: Subscribable iCal feed of kingdom events
ideas.audience: Members who are not always on Discord
ideas.user_value: One tap adds the kingdom calendar to Google, Apple or Outlook calendars, so the phone's own reminders work even for members who mute Discord. It needs no bot and no paid service, and updates arrive automatically.
ideas.spec:
1) GET /api/calendar.ics?lang=sk|cs (kingdom/views.py, plain Django view): Content-Type text/calendar; charset=utf-8, filename kd1035.ics (inline). VCALENDAR with VERSION:2.0, PRODID:-//KD 1035//Kalendar//SK, CALSCALE:GREGORIAN, X-WR-CALNAME:'KD 1035 – eventy' (CZ variant by lang), REFRESH-INTERVAL;VALUE=DURATION:PT6H and X-PUBLISHED-TTL:PT6H.
2) Occurrences for the next 60 days (plus running ones) of show_on_web events via kingdom/events.occurrences, each as a VEVENT: UID '<event id>-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>@kd1035', DTSTAMP, DTSTART/DTEND in UTC with 'Z' (DTEND omitted when duration 0), SUMMARY (name in lang with CS→SK fallback), URL (guide URL in lang when set, else the calendar page; SITE_URL based). RFC 5545 escaping of \ ; , and newlines, CRLF line endings, folding at 75 octets (UTF-8 safe). Stdlib only, no new dependency. Expanded occurrences rather than RRULE, so edits propagate and no VTIMEZONE is needed.
3) Calendar page: 'Pridať do kalendára' button → webcal://<host>/api/calendar.ics?lang=<lang> (host from location in the browser only) plus a secondary 'Kopírovať odkaz' button with the https URL (navigator.clipboard, feedback text). i18n in SK and CZ.
4) Cache-Control public, max-age=900.
TESTS: valid structure (BEGIN/END pairs), UTC times, escaping of ';' and ',', folding of a long Czech name stays valid UTF-8, hidden events excluded, lang=cs uses name_cs.
acceptance_criteria: /api/calendar.ics returns text/calendar that imports without errors into Google Calendar and validates with an iCalendar validator (manual check documented in the PR/commit).
Each public occurrence in the next 60 days is a VEVENT with a stable UID, UTC DTSTART/DTEND and the name in the requested language.
Hidden or inactive events never appear (test).
Lines are CRLF-terminated, folded at 75 octets without breaking multibyte characters, and special characters are escaped (tests).
The calendar page offers 'Pridať do kalendára' (webcal link) and 'Kopírovať odkaz' in SK and CZ, keyboard accessible.
ideas.risks: Google Calendar refreshes subscribed feeds slowly (often several hours), so the button tooltip should not promise instant updates. robots.txt already disallows /api/, which is fine for a feed.

ideas.title: Real 404 page in SK and CZ instead of a silent redirect home
ideas.title_sk: Skutočná stránka 404 (SK/CZ) namiesto tichého presmerovania domov
ideas.audience: Every visitor following an old or mistyped link; SEO
ideas.user_value: Today any unknown URL silently redirects to the home page (`{ path: '**', redirectTo: '' }`), so visitors from an outdated Discord or Facebook link don't know the page is gone and Czech visitors land on the Slovak home page. A clear 404 with ways forward keeps them on the site, and the URL stays as typed.
ideas.spec:
1) app.routes.ts: replace `{ path: '**', redirectTo: '' }` with `{ path: '**', component: NotFound }` at the root and add the same wildcard inside the 'cz' children, so /cz/xyz renders in Czech. Verify ng build does not try to prerender the wildcard (server route '**' stays Prerender for real pages; unknown URLs are served by nginx's existing `error_page 404 /index.csr.html` with a real 404 status).
2) pages/not-found/not-found.ts: app-page-header (crumbs Domov), title 'Táto stránka neexistuje', one sentence, buttons: Domov (btn--gold), Návody (i18n.guidePath('commanderi')), plus Kalendár when that page exists.
3) Seo: PageMeta.noindex (add it if discord-login has not yet) → meta robots noindex. When noindex is set, also remove the canonical and hreflang link elements so no canonical points at a non-existent URL; restore them on the next page.
4) Guide detail notFound state and invalid category on the list also call seo.set with noindex.
5) i18n 'notFound' section in sk.ts and cs.ts.
TESTS: frontend router test that /neexistuje resolves to NotFound and /cz/neexistuje too, with i18n.lang() = 'cs'; Seo test that noindex removes the canonical link; production check: `curl -I http://localhost:8080/neexistuje` → 404 (documented).
acceptance_criteria: /neexistuje shows the Slovak 404 page and the address bar keeps /neexistuje; /cz/neexistuje shows the Czech version.
The page has meta robots noindex and no canonical/hreflang links; navigating to a normal page afterwards restores the canonical and hreflang links and removes noindex.
Production nginx answers unknown URLs with HTTP 404 and the 404 content renders (no redirect to /).
An unknown guide slug and an invalid guide category also set noindex.
The page is responsive, keyboard accessible and fully translated.
ideas.risks: Low. Make sure the wildcard inside 'cz' does not shadow real Czech routes (order matters: the wildcard goes last). If noindex was already added by discord-login, reuse it rather than duplicating the logic.

reviews.reasons: The test send to a private channel solves a real problem. The only check today is 'Odoslať na Discord hneď' (kingdom/admin.py send_now), which posts to the real channel, pings the role and flips the status. Most of the rest is decoration or duplicates existing features. A test post shows Discord's real rendering, including <t:…> timestamps, so a hand-made HTML approximation of Discord adds maintenance (markdown subset, timestamp formatting, styling) for little extra value. 'Duplikovať o týždeň' duplicates Django's built-in `save_as = True` ('Uložiť ako nové'), which is one line, and once recurring-kingdom-events exists, irregular repeats are rare. The relative 'kedy' column and status pills are cosmetic. The custom object-tool URL <pk>/test/ adds a view, CSRF handling and a template for something an admin action already covers. The trimmed slice is about XS.

Reuse build_payload/send from recurring-kingdom-events (build after it); if KingdomEvent exists, offer the same test action rendering its next occurrence.
Tests as proposed for the test action (mock urlopen, assert URL, no role, status unchanged; missing URL → no call).

reviews.reasons: It has value once real events exist, and it is buildable: GuidesApi is the right pattern, the '**' Prerender server route covers the shell, and STATIC_PAGES/parseUrl/I18n.path/Seo need small extensions (I18n.path currently only accepts 'home' | 'about'; the Seo effect only has fixed texts for home/about). Three problems. (1) A 31-day agenda that expands a daily event (repeat_days=1) produces 31 identical rows, which bury the weekly events that matter. (2) Nothing is seeded, and Gether has not provided the event list. A header nav item that leads to 'Zatiaľ nie sú naplánované žiadne eventy' makes the kingdom look dead to migrants, which is the opposite of the stated value. (3) The header currently has 4 nav items (header.ts items()), not 5, but discord-login also adds a login control, so 'Kalendár' plus login plus lang switch must be checked together. Do not build this until recurring-kingdom-events is live and Gether has entered the regular public events.
required_changes: Show daily events once in a compact 'Každý deň' block (local + UTC time) above the agenda instead of expanding them per day; the agenda expands only events with repeat_days != 1.
Build only after recurring-kingdom-events is deployed and real public events exist (process gate); acceptance screenshots must use realistic data, not invented schedules committed anywhere.

Verify header fit at 320/900/1024/1280 together with the discord-login control if that feature has landed; if it does not fit, move 'Kalendár' to the drawer + footer + home teaser instead of the desktop bar.
Widen I18n.path() type and Seo fixed-text branch for 'calendar' explicitly; add parseUrl spec cases.

reviews.reasons: Mandatory before login goes live, and a factual, short legal page is an acceptable exception to the no-ballast rule. Its declared dependency is wrong, though: it lists Governor fields and a worker purge of rejected Governor rows, which need governor-registration, not just discord-login. Several statements would also be inaccurate as specified. 'Cookies: only session + csrftoken' leaves out the localStorage key 'kd1035.lang' (i18n.ts remember()). Every visitor gets csrftoken, because the header Auth service calls me/ with @ensure_csrf_cookie on every page. 'What we store' ignores server access logs: gunicorn runs with --access-logfile -, nginx logs client IPs, and Docker json-file logs have no rotation configured in either compose file. Discord is a third party in the login flow. Fonts are self-hosted via @fontsource (angular.json), so no Google Fonts transfer needs to be disclosed. The controller can be stated factually from existing data (Gether, the operator per the footer watermark, contact through his Discord via the Officer contact), but Gether must confirm it. Nothing may be invented.
required_changes: Governor registration was dropped (2026-10-08): no Governor fields and no purge job. Stored data = Discord ID, name, avatar hash and the in-game name (Player.ingame_name), seen only by the superadmin.

Content must list: localStorage language preference, csrftoken for every visitor (security), session cookie only for signed-in users, server access logs (IP, time, URL) with their retention, Discord as the OAuth provider (link to its policy).
Add log rotation to both compose files (logging: driver json-file, options max-size/max-file) so the stated log retention is true; mention the effective retention on the page.
Controller/contact: use Gether + the existing Discord contact unless Gether supplies something else; no invented addresses or legal claims ('GDPR-compliant' wording out).
CLAUDE.md rule as proposed (every new personal-data field → privacy page); purge test as proposed.

reviews.reasons: Useful for running the site with little effort, and the architecture is right. A heartbeat file on db_data, which backend and worker share in both compose files, avoids DB churn in the git snapshot. Backup info has to come from the worker because the production backend has no BACKUP_DIR mount (I checked docker-compose.yml). TEMPLATES['DIRS'] is empty today, and a same-named admin/index.html extending 'admin/index.html' is supported by Django. But the spec builds in coupling to features that may never ship: a conditional Governor block, flags for DISCORD_TEST_WEBHOOK_URL / DISCORD_STAFF_WEBHOOK_URL / Discord login via getattr defaults. Guide published/unpublished counts are ballast because the Guides changelist already filters by is_published. Medium value, so not in this batch.
required_changes: Only show blocks/flags for things that exist at build time (worker heartbeat, last backup, next 5 pending, failed in last 7 days, DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL/DISCORD_EVENT_ROLE_ID); each later feature adds its own row in its own change.
Drop the guide counts.
Provide the context via a simple template tag (`{% kd_overview as o %}` checking request.user.is_superuser) instead of wrapping admin.site.index or subclassing AdminSite.
Heartbeat write must swallow OSError with a log.warning (never crash the worker loop); test 'missing' and 'stale' states as proposed.

Small and consistent with the 'section hides' rule: it is not rendered while loading, on API failure or when there are no events, so the prerendered home is unchanged and an empty kingdom calendar never shows on the home page. It reuses EventsApi, so the extra cost is a component and i18n keys. It sits below the hero and alliance card, so the post-hydration shift is below the fold. It depends on public-event-calendar and should ship in the same batch, ideally as part of that slice, once real events exist. Apply the calendar's 'Každý deň' rule here too, so the 3 cards are not filled by one daily event repeated three times.

Moderate value for members who mute Discord. It needs only the stdlib, no paid service, and expanded occurrences avoid VTIMEZONE/RRULE pitfalls. The risk analysis is wrong in one important point: frontend/public/robots.txt has 'Disallow: /api/', and Google Calendar's URL subscription fetcher (Google-Calendar-Importer) has been reported to refuse feeds blocked by robots.txt ('Could not fetch the url because robots.txt prevents us from crawling the url'). As specified, the headline use case (Google Calendar) can fail. webcal:// has no handler on Android Chrome, so the copy-link button is the main path there. A daily event adds 60 VEVENTs to a subscriber's calendar, so per-event opt-out from the feed may matter. Later batch.
required_changes: Either add 'Allow: /api/calendar.ics' above the Disallow line in robots.txt or serve the feed at a non-/api path proxied by nginx and the ng dev proxy; verify a Google Calendar subscription manually and note it in the commit.
On the calendar page, make 'Kopírovať odkaz' (https URL) equally prominent, with a one-line hint for Google Calendar ('Pridať kalendár → Z webovej adresy'); no promise of instant updates.
Consider excluding repeat_days=1 events from the feed or adding a feed flag on KingdomEvent; decide explicitly.
RFC 5545 tests as proposed (CRLF, 75-octet UTF-8-safe folding, escaping).

reviews.reasons: I verified the bug. app.routes.ts ends with `{ path: '**', redirectTo: '' }` at the root, so /cz/anything redirects Czech visitors to the Slovak home '/', and the typed URL is lost. nginx already answers unknown paths with a real 404 status through `error_page 404 /index.csr.html` (frontend/nginx/default.conf.template), so the fix is purely client-side: a wildcard inside the 'cz' children (last) plus a root wildcard with a NotFound component. parseUrl('/neexistuje') returns page 'home' with rest '/neexistuje' (see i18n.spec), so NotFound must call seo.set({…, noindex: true}). Removing canonical/hreflang while noindex is set and restoring them afterwards is correct. Effort S is honest and it needs nothing from Gether. Notes for the builder: reuse PageMeta.noindex if discord-login added it; confirm ng build does not try to prerender the wildcard routes; the App's afterNextRender language redirect will move Czech browsers to /cz/<path>, which is the desired behaviour; add the 'Kalendár' button only if that page exists at build time. Not in this batch only because of the 4-item limit; it is the first candidate for the next one.
